structure: looped arc: hook -> rising action -> conflict -> comeback -> payoff
reference: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/xLpbXcIwQpk (idea only: 6 body zones, one chart, reps per move; no footage or artwork reused)

beats.hook: No gym? No problem. Six moves. Your whole body. Twelve minutes.
beats.rising: Legs: squats, fifteen reps. Chest: push-ups, twenty. Arms: chair dips, fifteen. Shoulders: pike push-ups, ten. Abs: dead bugs, ten each side. Fat burn: jumping jacks, thirty seconds.
beats.conflict: Round two. Your arms start shaking. Your form breaks. This is where most people quit.
beats.comeback: Don't quit. Drop to your knees for push-ups. Slow every rep down. Rest thirty seconds, then finish the round.
beats.payoff: Three rounds, three days a week. Add two reps every week. That's how a home workout builds muscle. Save this and follow for the full plan.
